pages.title: 01 // THE ILLUSIONS OF DEPTH
pages.content:
A computer screen is flat. Two dimensions: X and Y. How do you create infinite spatial depth without crashing browser RAM?

You harness Vanishing Point Convergence and Radial Dispersion. 5,000 particles moving Z-distance outwards in polar coordinates. Three.js Projection Matrix locking Field of View (FOV) across viewports. A 120 BPM camera Z-shake math synchronizing rhythm with audit consensus nodes.

pages.title: 02 // THREE LAYERS OF ZERO-404 PRECISION
pages.content:
To guarantee [ RENDER: WebGL GPU ] without frame drops, 3D space splits into three isolated depth layers:
1. Foreground Layer: 2D HUD cards, laser cursor, kinetic-parallax mouse response.
2. Midground Layer: Composite Monolith, data branching tree, ambient occlusion shadows.
3. Background Layer: Fluid noise field, 1px CAD grid, radial particle dispersion.

100% of PBR textures generated in-memory via dynamic canvas textures in RAM. Zero asset loading delays.

pages.title: 03 // 30-SECOND 5-ACT CHOREOGRAPHY
pages.content:
Act 1 (00:00 - 00:06): Dynamic 3D fluid noise field over 1px Swiss grid.
Act 2 (00:06 - 00:12): Glassmorphism interface layers dropping with 2nd-order spring physics.

Act 4 (00:18 - 00:24): Cyberpunk hexagonal tunnel with 4-model consensus nodes and 120 BPM Z-shake.
